audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Tactical Sweep (W) a 'true-damage cone'. Riot's text for W is a delayed cone whose outer half slows, deals extra damage and heals Camille — no true damage. The true damage sits on Precision Protocol (Q). Twisted Advance's untargetable flight is also never mentioned.
audit.why: A player building armour 'because her W is true damage' has the wrong model of the fight, and one who does not know his own W is untargetable never uses the dash to eat her Q recast.
audit.corrected: whys[3], whys[5], spikes[2], wants.foe[0], mid and late now put the true damage on Precision Protocol and describe W as the healing outer cone; report[5].t states the untargetable dash.
sources: champ-data/_kits/camille.json (Q carries trueDamage, W carries slow+heal)

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere and, as the packet flags, zero sequencing advice — nothing told the player what to wait for.
audit.why: Hookshot is 16s at rank 1 and must attach to a wall; Tactical Sweep is 15s; Twisted Advance is 14s. That ordering is the whole plan: fight in open lane, W after her hookshot is spent.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and mid now give the numbers and the wait-for-X line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Camille in both layers while whys[0] on the same page says Maokai owns it, and level 2 read Camille while whys[1] calls it an even trade window. The packet chart agrees with the prose on both.
audit.why: Two rows contradicted the text sitting next to them.
audit.corrected: Row 0 flipped to Maokai and row 1 to Skill in both layers, ratings adjusted. Rows 2-6 left alone — layers, prose and packet already agree that Camille owns them.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her engage/stun. W-peel it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hookshot: 16s at rank 1 and it needs a wall — in open lane it is half a spell. - Tactical Sweep: 15s, the outer cone is where her heal comes from. - Twisted Advance: 14s, spend it after her hookshot, never before.

edits.before: Levels 2-3 are my window. Once I have W (Twisted Advance) into Q (Bramble Smash) I can root her, knock her back, and proc Sap Magic to heal the trade right back before her E hookshot is even available to peel out. Hit her at the wide tip of my Q for the extra knockback. Don't waste W chasing a full-health Camille at level 1 when I only have one ability and no follow-up. Drop my E sapling on the brush and my own side so she can't freely hookshot the wall onto me.

Hit her at the wide tip of Q for the extra knockback. Don't waste W chasing a full-health Camille at level 1 when you have one ability and no follow-up. edits.before: From level 4 onward her E (hookshot) and W (true-damage cone with heal) are online, and that's when she starts kiting my cooldowns. My R at 6 helps a gank or peels a teamfight but it does almost nothing to my 1v1 with her, so don't treat it as a kill button. The honest play here is to stop trying to solo her: land W to set up my jungler, freeze if I can, and farm. Every extended duel I take post-6 her W heal and Q true-damage chip out-trade my Sap Magic.
edits.after: From level 4 her Hookshot (16s) and Tactical Sweep (15s) are both online, and that's when she starts kiting your cooldowns. Your R at 6 helps a gank or peels a teamfight but does almost nothing to the 1v1, so don't treat it as a kill button. The honest play is to stop soloing her: land W to set up your jungler, freeze if you can, and farm. Wait her hookshot out before committing — post-6 her cone heal and Q procs out-trade Sap Magic.

edits.before: Once Camille has 2+ items she out-duels me flat — my tank damage doesn't scale and her true damage ignores my resistances, so a solo fight is hers. My only late edge is the teamfight: my R (Nature's Grasp) brambles and W lockdown can lock her down before she R-isolates one of my carries. Never get caught split alone, because her R cage turns it into the exact 1v1 she wins. Group, peel, and let my CC do the work my dueling can't.
edits.after: Once Camille has 2+ items she out-duels you flat — your tank damage doesn't scale and Precision Protocol's true damage ignores your resistances, so a solo fight is hers. notes: Camille's kit file carries derived 'channel' and 'untargetable' flags on The Hextech Ultimatum that Riot's description does not support (it reads as a dash that anchors the target), so nothing here claims her R can be interrupted or dodged. The true-damage correction rests on the kit's flag placement (Q trueDamage, W slow+heal) rather than explicit tooltip wording — confidence Medium, worth a wiki confirm before it is used elsewhere.
